== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[A Close Race (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/013e17be50f1206449af38f66ba66be77ae8f27c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif Holotable image repository, commit 013e17b] “UC Spy Shield Erratas”, 24 July 2024, for the PC's July 2024 Undercover-spy shield errata. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/14/VD-L-acloserace-PC-E1.png Internet Archive item].
